top_signals.title: Bitcoin hovers near $77,000 as global bond selloff tests post-rally resilience
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin hovers near $77,000 as global bond yields surge and renewed U.S.-Iran tensions push oil prices higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Thailand adopts crypto Travel Rule with self-custodial wallet checks
top_signals.summary: Thailand adopted a crypto Travel Rule requiring digital asset operators to verify control of self-custodial wallets and retain transaction data for five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
